title: lophophora echinata var. lutea
intro: Lophophora echinata var. lutea, commonly known as the yellow peyote or golden peyote, is a rare and lesser-known cactus species found in Mexico. This plant is part of the Lophophora genus and is known for its psychoactive properties, which are attributed to its unique bioactive constituents. The health benefits associated with Lophophora echinata var. lutea include potential anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antifungal properties, as well as its traditional use in traditional medicine to treat various ailments. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including alkaloids such as peyote alkaloids, which have been reported to have sedative, analgesic, and anti-anxiety effects.
